short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
current_stage: ECO.EVO0 / CAL1-B Relative Vertical Light Competition
progress_note: CAL1-A is accepted on exact Windows Godot 4.7.1 double evidence. Parent PH3 (217 assertions), PH3 restart (5), PH3C (97), PH3C restart (6), CAL1-A baseline (1094) and two fresh-process probes all passed. Canonical CAL1-A baseline_hash=280980c13b2545e66af94d10cc35f707c506365c65df9efeddb07b037588cb0f and legacy PH3C hash=294ebcd81db924421a916ad599711146c4047f0e295fe76f715fff11e548b7fb. HEIGHT_LOW is winner in REFERENCE/SHADE/SUN/DRY, HEIGHT_HIGH ranks 7th in all four, and structural_cost is the strongest HEIGHT_LOW-vs-HEIGHT_HIGH driver everywhere. This opens CAL1-B. CAL1-B must add neighbour-relative vertical light competition without altering accepted PH3 coefficients; no-neighbour/equal-height controls must be neutral and dense overlap must create a relative height payoff.
next_stage: Implement and validate CAL1-B Relative Vertical Light Competition as a separate research mechanism. Do not calibrate accepted PH3 coefficients. After CAL1-B acceptance proceed to CAL1-C crown/root competition; after CAL1 closure begin ECO.EVO1_PLANT_WORLD_PROOF.
